北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感 -9℃，阳光虽好，保暖别忘哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels like -9℃. Despite the sun, keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 1℃，北风 3级，阴冷潮湿，多穿点哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 1℃ with a 3-grade north wind. It's damp and chilly, dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 1℃，阴天微凉。记得多加衣物，注意保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 1℃, cloudy and cool. Remember to add layers and stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 9℃，北风 4级。风力较大，出门小心着凉！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 9℃ with a 4-grade north wind. It's windy, watch out for chills!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 12℃，东北风 4级。风力不小，注意防风哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 12℃ with a 4-grade northeast wind. It's quite windy, stay sheltered!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 -1℃，阴冷潮湿。出门保暖，别着凉了。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like -1℃, damp and chilly. Stay warm when out, don't catch a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -2℃，多云微风。温度较低，注意添衣保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -2℃, cloudy with light wind. It's cold, remember to add clothes.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 3℃，阴天有风。微凉，记得及时增添衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 3℃, cloudy and windy. It's cool, remember to add clothes.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 -1℃，阴冷湿滑。路面小心，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like -1℃, damp and chilly. Be careful on roads, stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 -2℃，湿度 100%。多云潮湿，注意防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like -2℃, 100% humidity. Cloudy and damp, remember to keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨，体感 6℃。出门别忘带伞，注意防潮保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain, feels like 6℃. Don't forget your umbrella, stay dry and warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -25℃！严寒来袭，务必全副武装防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -25℃! Extreme cold, bundle up to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -22℃，阳光也冷。注意防寒保暖，别冻着！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -22℃, even with sun. Stay warm, don't get frozen!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 8℃，晴天风力 3级。体感舒适，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels like 8℃, sunny with a 3-grade wind. Pleasant, but mind the sun.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 10℃，多云有风。温度适中，注意别着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 10℃, cloudy and windy. Mild, but take care not to catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -7℃，多云有风。出门防寒保暖，注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -7℃, cloudy and windy. Stay warm and safe outdoors.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -16℃，北风 4级！风寒效应强，全副武装！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -16℃ with a 4-grade north wind! Strong wind chill, bundle up!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
